lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace E] [inst_4 : BorelSpace E] {F : Type u_2} [inst_5 : NormedAddCommGroup F] (W : E → ℝ),
  Continuous W →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W x)) MeasureTheory.volume →
      ∀ (a : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp F 2 (MeasureTheory.volume.tilted fun x => -W x))),
        MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrable (fun x => ‖↑↑a x‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          ∀ (K : Set E), IsCompact K → MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun x => ↑↑a x) 2 (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K)
approved_definition_context: Lp functions are equivalence classes modulo almost-everywhere equality; displayed coercions select representative functions.
The tilted measure normalizes the exponential of the displayed potential relative to the base measure.
LocallyIntegrable means integrability on some neighborhood of each point. A restricted measure measures intersections with the indicated set.
MemLp at exponent two includes almost-everywhere strong measurability and finite squared-norm integral.
